verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit reviews every PR automatically within moments using multiple models, detects low-quality AI-generated 'slop' PRs, and can block merges through its request-changes workflow until actionable feedback is resolved. It also applies agent guideline files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules) as review criteria, runs inside coding-agent loops such as Claude Code, and offers a cross-repo Triage queue for handling high PR volume. Community reports are mixed: some users say it catches bugs Claude Code misses, while one team removed it over verbosity and false positives. Missing for 10: independent evidence of review accuracy and throughput on agent-authored PRs at scale, and an answer to the documented false-positive and noise complaints.
